name: Mushroom Barley Soup
ingredients: ¼ cup (50 g) pearl barley, rinsed
steps: Dry-sauté the mushrooms in a wide pot for 5 minutes until they release their water and brown, then set aside.
Heat the oil and cook the onion, carrot and celery for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and thyme.
Add the barley and stock, bring to a boil, then simmer covered for 25 minutes.
Return the mushrooms with the soy sauce and cook for 10 more minutes until the barley is tender.
Add the tofu cubes for the last 5 minutes of cooking.
Season with pepper and finish with parsley.
note: Barley is rich in beta-glucan fibre; the soup is naturally low in saturated fat.
